stories.title: CPSC Urgent Warning — Slide Playset Kills 17-Month-Old, Destroy Immediately

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text: URGENT: CPSC says stop using Wenzhou Yidian Model WPX-4 slide playsets immediately. A 17-month-old died from head and neck entrapment. The manufacturer won't recall — CPSC says dispose of it. Don't sell or give away. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text: Have a colorful plastic playset with a tunnel, slide, and basketball hoop? Check if it's the Wenzhou Yidian WPX-4. CPSC says dispose of it — a toddler died in it. Colors: red, navy, coffee, gray, green, yellow. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting

stories.title: RSV Season Is 8 Weeks Out — What COS Families Need to Know Now

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Colorado's RSV season typically starts in late October — about 10 weeks away. Now that kids are back in school, it's time to ask your pediatrician about nirsevimab for infants under 8 months. Earlier is better. #COSParenting #ColoradoSprings #COSKids #PikesPeakParenting
